Button me `callback_data` do, phir callback handler me `query.data` check karke jawab bhejo (`query.answer()` bhi karna mat bhoolna). Try karke btana kya hua.
yaar git kaise use karte hain
Arre yaar, basic flow: `git add .`, `git commit -m "msg"`, `git push`. Pehle `git pull` kr lena taaki conflict kam ho.

Agar `uvicorn` nahi mila toh `pip install uvicorn`, aur command me file naam aur app naam sahi daalo.
Pull nhi ho rha
`git stash` se current changes safe rakh ke pull karo, phir `git stash pop`.
JSON kya hota hai bhai
JSON data ko text me store karne ka simple format hai, key-value pairs ke form me. Ek chhota example bhi de sakti hoon. Agar kisi step pe atko toh puch lena.

Pehle `yt-dlp -U` ya pip se update karo. Phir bhi na chale toh poora error message bhejo.

async me delay kaise lagau yaar

btw performance badhana hai
Aksar repeated API ya DB calls slow karti hain. Caching add karo aur unnecessary loops hatao.
Callback query handle kaise kru
Callback handler me hamesha `await query.answer()` kro, warna user ke button pe loading hota rehta hai.
Merge conflict aa gaya pls
Conflict me file kholo, `<<<<<<<`, `=======` aur `>>>>>>>` markers hatao, dono changes sahi se merge karo, phir `git add` aur `git commit`. Aur detail chahiye toh bolo.
KeyError ka matlab kya hai
Pehle `print(data)` ya `print(data.keys())` karo. Aksar API response ka structure alag hota hai jo hum assume karte hain.
